description: Buffer pool health: PLE (incl. NUMA), cache hit %, physical page I/O rates, lazy writes / free-list stalls, fleet snapshot, and per-database buffer occupancy. /sec counters use rate([5m]). Collectors: mssql_buffer_pool (180s); per-database panels need opt-in mssql_buffer_pool_database (30m). Empty database panels = collector not enabled on profile.

targets.expr: count(rate(mssql_buffer_pool_counter{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", counter="Free list stalls/sec"}[5m]) > 0.1) or vector(0)
max by (instance) (rate(mssql_buffer_pool_counter{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", counter="Free list stalls/sec"}[5m]))
max by (instance) (rate(mssql_buffer_pool_counter{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", counter="Free list stalls/sec"}[5m]))

panels.description: Per-database cached/dirty pages from sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors. Requires opt-in mssql_buffer_pool_database collector (30m min_interval).
panels.title: Buffer usage by database (mssql_buffer_pool_database)

panels.description: Collector: mssql_buffer_pool_database (opt-in, 30m). Empty = collector not enabled on profile.
panels.title: Max Cached DB

panels.description: Highest single-database share of instance buffer pool pages (excludes _Free).

targets.expr: max((mssql_buffer_pool_database_pages{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", db!="_Free"} / on(instance) group_left() sum by (instance) (mssql_buffer_pool_database_pages{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db!="_Free"})) * 100) or vector(0)
